title: Usage bar: name Maestro, not Claude Code, as the sender of its usage request
summary: The usage bar's request to Anthropic now names Maestro and the app's own version instead of presenting itself as Claude Code; one new test, and a live request with the new name returned 200.
friction: The main-checkout dependency install in preflight was skipped: other sessions' suites were running against this machine and a reinstall could disturb them
lessons_learned: Read the app version from the Tauri app handle, not CARGO_PKG_VERSION: release builds bump only the app version, so the crate version stays 0.3.0
